website_metadata.notes: Foreign bank (Korea) with India branches at Chennai and Gurugram on global.1qbank.com (1Q Bank platform). India personal-bank section (/pb/ma/main?countryCode=IN) only exposes login-gated 'Application for Deposit' / 'Application history' flows and FX rate pages (/lounge/chennai/et/rate/index.html); no public INR domestic FD rate card published. Branch 'lounge' pages are JS-rendered and returned empty to WebFetch.

warnings: FD product exists per aggregator descriptions but bank publishes no public rate table; rates are behind login/application flow.
